description: Defines a reusable Flutter widget named SampleCard, which displays a stylized card with an icon, title, subtitle, and a chevron indicator. The widget applies specific theming, border, shadow, and layout styling as per the Ocean Professional style.

classes.name: SampleCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a styled card with customizable title, subtitle, and icon.
